text.en: The pay-roll answered the manifest's last question — where the coin came from. The deserters were paid against a lime contract that the League never signed. The payments were routed through a dead pit in the hills.
text.id: Daftar gaji itu menjawab pertanyaan terakhir manifest — dari mana koin itu berasal. Para pembelot dibayar lewat kontrak kapur yang tak pernah ditandatangani Liga. Pembayarannya disalurkan melalui lubang mati di perbukitan.

text.en: The Chalkpit. The League's lime workings, abandoned mid-dig when its crew's pay never arrived — because Durn's ledgers had already spent it. A dust-white spur branches off the trade road past the salt track. The pit should be empty. If it is not, I want to know whose hands are in it.
text.id: Lubang Kapur itu. Tambang kapur Liga, ditinggalkan di tengah penggalian ketika gaji krunya tak pernah datang — karena buku Durn sudah membelanjakannya. Sebuah simpangan putih-debu bercabang dari jalan dagang melewati jejak garam. Lubang itu seharusnya kosong. Kalau tidak, aku ingin tahu tangan siapa yang ada di dalamnya.

text.en: I'll walk the chalk spur and see what the pit is keeping.
text.id: Akan kutempuh simpangan kapur itu dan kulihat apa yang disimpan lubangnya.

text.en: Mind the rim — a worked face does not forgive a careless step. And warden: if someone down there claims the League's stamp, they are lying. The League still has its seal. Whoever cut chalk under it is cutting for someone else.
text.id: Jaga tepiannya — muka galian tak memaafkan langkah ceroboh. Dan warden: kalau ada di bawah sana yang mengaku memegang cap Liga, mereka berdusta. Liga masih menyimpan segelnya. Siapa pun yang memotong kapur di bawahnya memotong untuk orang lain.
